parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the container cluster.

parameters.name: CriteriaType
parameters.description:
The type of the query condition. Valid values:

*   **ID**
*   **RULE_NAME**
*   **SRC_TARGET**
*   **DST_TARGET**
*   **DST_PORT**
*   **RULE_SWITCH**
*   **INTERCEPTOR_TYPE**

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-interception-rule-page --cluster-id cc41de13ab5474210bc0ce772a0090000 --criteria 80 --criteria-type DST_PORT --current-page 1 --page-size 50 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListInterceptionRulePage --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 50 --ClusterId cc41de13ab5474210bc0ce772a0090000 --CurrentPage 1 --CriteriaType DST_PORT --Criteria 80
